headline: Woman dies after being hit by state minister's car in Bogura
summary: Firoza Begum, 60, passed away at a hospital after being struck by the official vehicle of the State Minister for Public Administration and Food, Abdul Bari.
details: Firoza Begum, a 60-year-old woman from Gopinathpur village in the Kichak union of Shibganj upazila, died on Friday afternoon at the TMSS Medical College Hospital in Bogura.
The accident occurred around 9:00 AM on the Mokamtala-Joypurhat road in the Kichak union area of Shibganj upazila.
State Minister Abdul Bari was traveling from Dhaka to his parliamentary constituency, Joypurhat-2, on an official visit when the incident happened.
According to local sources, Firoza Begum was attempting to cross the highway when she came in front of the minister's car.
In an attempt to avoid the obstacle, the driver lost control of the vehicle, causing it to veer off the road and crash into a nearby paddy field.
The collision left Firoza Begum critically injured, while State Minister Abdul Bari and his wife, Najma Ara Begum, were also injured in the crash.
The State Minister received primary treatment following the accident and later returned home.
Local residents rescued Firoza Begum and rushed her to the TMSS Medical College Hospital, where she eventually succumbed to her injuries.
caption:
A 60-year-old woman has died after being hit by a state minister's official vehicle in Bogura.

Firoza Begum, a 60-year-old woman from Gopinathpur village in the Kichak union of Shibganj upazila, died on Friday afternoon at the TMSS Medical College Hospital in Bogura.

The accident occurred around 9:00 AM on the Mokamtala-Joypurhat road in the Kichak union area of Shibganj upazila.

State Minister Abdul Bari was traveling from Dhaka to his parliamentary constituency, Joypurhat-2, on an official visit when the incident happened.

According to local sources, Firoza Begum was attempting to cross the highway when she came in front of the minister's car.

In an attempt to avoid the obstacle, the driver lost control of the vehicle, causing it to veer off the road and crash into a nearby paddy field.

The collision left Firoza Begum critically injured, while State Minister Abdul Bari and his wife, Najma Ara Begum, were also injured in the crash.

The State Minister received primary treatment following the accident and later returned home.

Local residents rescued Firoza Begum and rushed her to the TMSS Medical College Hospital, where she eventually succumbed to her injuries.

headline: 987 dead as measles outbreak death toll rises
summary: The Health Minister has announced a nationwide vaccination campaign to combat the surge in measles cases.
details: The death toll from the measles outbreak has reached 987, with one more death reported in the last 24 hours.
In response to the rising number of casualties, the Health Minister has announced that a nationwide vaccination campaign will be launched.
The campaign aims to curb the spread of the virus and prevent further deaths across the country.
Health authorities are working to implement the drive to ensure widespread coverage and protect vulnerable populations.
